Yayātitaruṇānanda
or Taruṇānanda. drama.
--by Vallisahāyakavi of Vādhūla gotra. This drama was intended to be staged in the vernal festival of God Mārgasahāya worshipped a. Viriñcipuram.
MD. 12626. MT. 7146.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sns. 682. 725.

Yayātidevayānīcarita
drama. This is apparently intended to be staged but was written without an. division into acts an. without following the canons of dramatic composition. GD. 1563A. Granthappura p. 78 (no. 1563). MD. 12627.
C.. Devayānīcarita.

Yayātivijaya
q. in Sāhityadarpaṇa, NS. Press edn. p. 318. Veṅk. Press edn. p. 499. Chowk. edn. p. 409.
